message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk" on Thursday morning, Yuriko provided feedback on the demo website, which Li Hua had showcased. Specifically, Yuriko expressed appreciation for the color scheme, describing it as perfect and reflecting the gentle vibe of the studio. She then suggested adding a section for community outreach programs, which would highlight the impact of her work. Yuriko proposed including details about the programs she offers and some testimonials from participants, as well as photos from past events. Li Hua responded positively to Yuriko's suggestions, indicating that they could indeed add a section for community outreach programs. He also agreed to brainstorm some ideas for this feature and noted that he would help Yuriko with the layout and presentation to ensure the section would be engaging and impactful. Li Hua expressed enthusiasm about incorporating the elements Yuriko had suggested, stating that they could create a section that would showcase her work effectively and provide a personal touch to the site.
